workload.prompt: A cinematic red fox walking through fresh snow, soft morning light.

comparison.note: The warm ratio compares the second request in each two-request batch; this is one true warm sample per route, not a stable median. Resident and streaming use identical checkpoint, prompt, seed, sampler and Metal flags. PNG container metadata differs but decoded pixels are equal.

limitations: Peak RSS is sampled at the 100 ms job-poll cadence; physical footprint is taken from the child process lifetime maximum.
This validates Q3_K_S at 256² only; it does not qualify every GGUF quantization or 1024² streaming policy.
Streaming offload is intentionally routed to sd.cpp and cannot be combined with native MLX GPU+ANE or in_memory_merge LoRA.
